system_description.narrative_title: France's unrest triggers European political and economic disruption
system_description.narrative_summary: A wave of mass protests in France has escalated into widespread riots and looting, exposing deep social anger over government spending decisions and rising living costs and putting President Macron's administration into crisis. The unrest is producing concrete economic fallout — market declines, bond and currency weakness — while shaping EU-level debates on energy, emissions and industrial protection; similar protests and clashes elsewhere in Europe increase contagion risk.
system_description.scope: The system includes French domestic politics and public policy (spending/energy decisions), protest movements and public sentiment, law-enforcement/security responses, national financial markets and public debt dynamics, major industrial sectors affected (notably automotive and energy), and EU-level policy negotiations and trade responses; media amplification and cross-border protest contagion are also inside the boundary.
system_description.super_system: The European political-economic system (EU institutions, regional markets, cross-border trade and diplomatic relations)
adjacent_subsystems: Automotive and EV industry (manufacturers, supply chains, market share battles)
Energy and fuel markets (prices, subsidies, electricity/gas policy)
EU institutions and trade policy (emissions rules, tariffs, industrial protection)
Social movements and labour/unions (student, union and grassroots mobilizations)
evidence_headlines: Mass protests in France spiral into worst riots in years

variables.name: Public discontent level
variables.description: Measures the aggregate intensity of popular dissatisfaction with economic conditions, public services and policy decisions across the population.

variables.name: Protest activity intensity
variables.description: Measures the current frequency, scale and geographic spread of organized demonstrations, rallies and street actions.

variables.name: Protest mobilization capacity
variables.description: Measures the stock of organizational resources, networks and logistical capability available to social movements and protest groups.

variables.name: Riot and violent incident intensity
variables.description: Measures the incidence and severity of violent confrontations, property damage and disorder associated with civil unrest.

variables.name: Law-enforcement response intensity
variables.description: Measures the scale, forcefulness and operational tempo of policing and security actions deployed in response to unrest.

variables.name: Policing legitimacy
variables.description: Measures public perceptions of the law-enforcement apparatus's fairness, lawfulness and social acceptance.

variables.name: Political stability
variables.description: Measures the resilience of governing arrangements, the continuity of executive authority and risk of major political disruption.

variables.name: Fiscal pressure on public finances
variables.description: Measures the degree of budgetary strain from deficits, spending commitments and revenue shortfalls affecting public finance flexibility.

variables.name: Sovereign debt and public credit risk
variables.description: Measures market and perception-based indicators of the risk that public debt service and refinancing will be impaired or repriced.

variables.name: Domestic financial market volatility
variables.description: Measures short-term variability in equity, bond and related domestic financial asset prices and liquidity conditions.

variables.name: Media attention intensity
variables.description: Measures the volume, prominence and emotional framing of coverage across broadcast, print and digital channels about the unrest and its causes.

variables.name: Energy price level
variables.description: Measures prevailing consumer and wholesale prices for key energy sources, notably fuels and electricity.

variables.name: Energy supply disruption risk
variables.description: Measures the probability and expected severity of interruptions to energy supply chains and delivery infrastructure.

variables.name: Industrial sector disruption
variables.description: Measures the rate and extent of interruptions to production, distribution and operations in key industrial sectors.

variables.name: Trade protectionism pressure
variables.description: Measures political and policy pressure to adopt tariffs, import curbs or other trade barriers in response to perceived competitive threats.

variables.name: Cross-border protest contagion risk
variables.description: Measures the susceptibility and tendency for domestic unrest dynamics to spread or inspire protests in other jurisdictions.

catalysts.title: Nationwide student, union, Yellow Vest protests
catalysts.description: Planned coordinated protests by students, trade unions and Yellow Vests across France are set to mobilize large demonstrations in the near term.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Students, trade unions and Yellow Vests set to protest across France'; widespread marches reported.

catalysts.title: Expansion of curfews and tougher police measures
catalysts.description: Government moves to broaden partial curfews and escalate policing tactics in response to weekend riots, restricting movement and increasing enforcement.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'French Prime Minister calls for partial curfews after weekend riots'; Macron urges calm.

catalysts.title: Sustained riots and looting
catalysts.description: Violent unrest, looting and arson continue or reoccur across cities, maintaining high intensity of disorder and damage.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'France reels after ‘unprecedented’ violent riots', 'Protests across France spiral into riots and looting'.

catalysts.title: French sovereign and market repricing
catalysts.description: Debt fears and market selling intensify after unrest, driving bond yields higher, equity falls and increased sovereign risk pricing.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'French markets tumble', 'French unrest compounds debt crisis fears', 'French debt worries spill into stocks'.

catalysts.title: Cross-border protest spread in Europe
catalysts.description: Unrest in France inspires or coincides with protests and clashes in other European cities, elevating contagion risk.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Violent protests multiply across Europe', 'Protesters clash with police in Brussels', 'Milan police clash with protesters'.

catalysts.title: EU/European travel warnings and security advisories
catalysts.description: European governments issue travel advisories and security warnings for citizens in France, altering cross-border movement and perceptions.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'European governments warn citizens over security in France after riots'.

catalysts.title: Political showdown with EU forces
catalysts.description: Right-wing opposition signals escalation of confrontation with EU institutions, raising domestic political tensions and policy risks.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'France’s Marine Le Pen vows ‘trial of strength’ with EU' and related political fallout headlines.
